text_block_list.name: Umamusume on the Track
text_block_list.text: Fight, oh! Fight, oh!

All I can hear are the footsteps of the Umamusume.
They too must be working hard day after day for their own victory.

We set our next target as the Asahi Hai FS, but
its grade is the highest tier, a G1.
Under normal circumstances, just qualifying for the race is a struggle.
However, considering Biwa Hayahide's immense potential, there was no cause for concern.

If she steadily gains real race experience
and continues to grow—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh, you came too?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I can't really talk either.
Her running simply captivates people, after all."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...It has always been that way.
Following her gaze toward the track—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah! Today's the day I winnn!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Ama-san, you're loud.

There was a pre-debut Umamusume, alongside
the hot-blooded Miho Dormitory Head, Hishi Amazon—

Biwa Hayahide's younger sister,
and the one drawing more attention than anyone else right now.
—It was Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Heheh, sounds good. So, what's the distance?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh, the Mile? That's an unexpected number.
...Might as well ask, what made you decide on that?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I want to slice through the wind at full speed right from the start.
Right now, I am starving for speed...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...Ha! Going all out right from the start, are ya?
Nice, this is gonna be one fun showdown...!"

text_block_list.name: Referee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
S-Senpais, we're about to start!
On your mark, get set—
What unfolded from there was utterly breathtaking.

"A fierce intensity as if baring their fangs at each other.
The heat radiating from the two drew in all who watched."

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Go, Hishi Ama-senpa~i!
Brian-senpai, do your best~!
However, during the final stretch of the race, it happened.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!
(SWOOSH!!)

Cutting through the clamor was her terrifying late burst.
A momentary silence falls over the track.

"...If Narita Brian and Biwa Hayahide
were to compete against each other."

How far ahead do I have to run,
how large a lead do I need to take,
—for her not to catch up to me?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-kun? Are you all right?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you were making quite an intense face for that to be the case.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Wearing the exact same expression I used to have.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Since the opportunity presents itself, let us use that experience
to articulate the impressions you are feeling right now."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian will become—
a presence truly worthy of being called "The Strongest."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Even while recognizing her overwhelming talent,
to still reach out toward it might truly be
the act of a fool.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My younger self was one such example. Before I knew it,
I was overtaken, and in my panic at seeing her back fade into the distance—
(Craaash!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I got injured.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
While hospitalized, I couldn't stop thinking about it from my bed.
And as a result, I...
choice_data_list: Working tirelessly on the "winning formula" without giving up

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes. With that rare Trainer of mine
who took an interest in me, not my sister.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Forget being fools—
maybe we really are the biggest idiots in the whole world."
HAYAHIIIIIDEEEE!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oops. Seems our conversation ends here.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hey, Ticket. You too, Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haaah. How on earth am I supposed to keep this runaway girl under control?
(Narita Taishin—a friend of Biwa Hayahide who debuted this year. Despite her petite frame, they say she runs with unimaginable sharpness.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, Ticket,
who calls out to someone at a time like this?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Because, because Hayahide was there!!!

(Winning Ticket—the energetic girl is another one
of Biwa Hayahide's peers. I hear the three of them,
including Narita Taishin from earlier, are great friends.)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
There was something I really, really wanted to say!
You know! All of us...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You finally made your debuuuut!! Congraaaatulaaations~~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wait, you're crying at that?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief. And?
Why don't you get to the point already?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry, sorry! Hey, you two!!
Since we're all here, wanna run together?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Just like that time, run 2,400 meters!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's an old story. Back when we first enrolled,
Ticket insisted on running 2,400 meters
during class time trials, you see.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it's the exact same distance as the Derby!!!

It is a stage an Umamusume can challenge only once in her life.
A pinnacle race of which it is said every Umamusume in the world desires the honor.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Normally, newly enrolled students only run about 1,000 meters,
but... she and I took off running.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yep, these three. Ever since then, the three of us
naturally started teaming up often. Heh, takes me back.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, just like this, right?!!
...WOOOOOOOAAAAAHHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey, wait up! You idiot!!
Why are you running ahead...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, looks like I got a late start.
Well then, Trainer-kun. Mind if I join in?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

"And chasing after Winning Ticket
and Narita Taishin who dashed off first, she began to run as well."

"...I wonder if I'll be able
to keep seeing this scenery in the future."
—The next day. I heard a rumor.

It seems Narita Taishin and Winning Ticket
are planning to enter the Junior-class GⅠ Hopeful Stakes.

Though different from the Asahi Hai FS that Biwa Hayahide is running in,
it was still a GⅠ race.
...The pinnacle race of the Junior Class.

It seems Narita Brian, who I'll face one day...
isn't the only formidable rival around.
